comparison.metric: Sum of synchronous acceptance-leaf kernel checks plus lemma insertion, 1ms clock. Complete acceptance obligations in each representation, different leaf counts. Not full process time.
comparison.reason: Baseline whole-process time is unknown; 749.257s is only the historical leaf sum.

memory.scope: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo native high-water counters for this process only; queries at <=20ms plus post-exit. PeakWorkingSetSize resident bytes; PeakPagefileUsage process commit bytes.

memory_scope_clarification: The raw report scope phrase <=20ms describes the requested wait timeout, not a scheduler upper bound. Queries occurred around requested 20ms waits; OS scheduling may lengthen intervals. Native PeakWorkingSetSize and PeakPagefileUsage are lifetime high-water counters. The post-exit query succeeded, so peaks cover the full process lifetime; these are not sampled maxima of current working set. No child processes included. PeakPagefileUsage is process commit, not disk IO.
wall_scope: Clock starts before opening output logs and Popen, stops after wait reports exit; log decoding/reading follows outside clock. Generic module builds are separate steps. No own .olean or baseline Chromium.olean is imported by the fresh instance source.
